```python
import collections
import itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ITEMS = ['apple', 'banana']

def task_func(a, b, items=ITEMS):
    left = [] if a is None else a
    right = [] if b is None else b

    combined = list(itertools.chain(left, right))
    counter = collections.Counter(combined)
    counts = [counter[item] for item in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(items, counts)
    ax.set_xlabel('Items')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
    ax.set_title('Frequency of Predefined Items in Combined List')

    return ax
```
